summary: fix(admin-panel): update the Authorized Browser Services note
description:
Because:

- The note said Firefox Desktop "currently mints" a Sync-scoped token on every flow.
- The Firefox Desktop fix (FXA-14263) is now in production.

This commit:

- Keeps the first two sentences of the note in Account/index.tsx.
- Says Sync rows are accurate for sign-ins on or after Aug 19, 2026.
- Says earlier Sync rows can come from a non-Sync browser-service sign-in.
- Adds one test to index.test.tsx for the date text.
- Includes a Prettier rewrap of one existing test line.

Closes FXA-14580
